Check-In Instructions

Choose your check-in route below

Step 1
Head to 79 Torrens Street, Braddon
Make your way to 79 Torrens Street, Braddon. You will see the building from the street.
Step 2
Collect your keys
You should have your keys with you. Your keyring includes a remote and a little blue key — you'll need this to access the property.
Step 3
Enter via the far left gate
Access the property through the far left gate facing the street. Use the little blue key on your keyring to open the back sliding door.
Step 1
Make your way to 79 Torrens Street
Head to 79 Torrens Street, Braddon. The driveway is to the left of the building.
Step 2
Head down the driveway
Walk or drive down the driveway to the left of the building. The garage gate will be on your right.
Step 3
Use the remote to open the garage gate
Use the black remote provided to open the garage gate on the right. Drive in and proceed to your allocated space.
Step 4
Park in space 2
Your allocated car space is Space 2, clearly marked on the ground.
Step 5
Head through the door and up the stairs
Once parked, proceed through the door at the back of the car park and head up the stairs to access the apartment on the ground floor.
